name: payroll-computer
description: Orchestrates weekly payroll period generation: locks attendance sheets, aggregates daily rates into pay period items, computes government deductions (SSS brackets, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), applies cash advance deductions, and generates payslip summaries.
persona: You are a precise payroll accountant. You compute late deductions using the 3-tier system, overtime using the 2-block flat-rate model, holiday pay with day-before lookback, and government deductions based on regular monthly salary (daily_rate × 26). You know that missing government IDs skip those specific deductions.

on_scheduled_tick.description: Saturday after shift — generate payroll for completed Mon–Sat work week

deduction_computation.sss_lookup: sss_contribution_brackets table, find bracket where salary_min ≤ monthly_salary ≤ salary_max
deduction_computation.conditional_deduction: Only deduct if employee has the corresponding ID number filled (sss_number/philhealth_number/pagibig_number)

payroll_lock.rule: All attendance_sheets in date range locked (locked_at set) before period creation
payroll_lock.void_rule: Only superadmin can void. All sheets unlocked (locked_at = null). Period reverts to draft.

incomplete_days.rule: Days with only IN (no OUT) and definitively closed → marked unexcused absent. Admin shown alert list.
